title: Natural comparison of right-pinched and arrow mapping spaces
statement:
Use quasicategories, internal functor simplicial sets and the right-pinched mapping space $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(x,y)$ of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For a quasicategory $\mathcal D$ and vertices $x,y$, define the arrow mapping space
$$U_{\mathcal D}(x,y)=\{x\}\times_{\mathcal D,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal D)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,\mathcal D}\{y\}.$$
Both $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(x,y)$ and $U_{\mathcal D}(x,y)$ are Kan complexes. Precomposition in degree $n$ with the map $\Delta^n\times\Delta^1\to\Delta^{n+1}$ induced by $(a,0)\mapsto a$ and $(a,1)\mapsto n+1$ (interchanging the two product factors to use the internal-functor convention) defines the right-pinch inclusion
$$j_{\mathcal D,x,y}:\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal D}(x,y)\longrightarrow U_{\mathcal D}(x,y).$$
This is a homotopy equivalence, natural under every simplicial functor $\mathcal D\to\mathcal D'$ carrying $x,y$ to the specified endpoints.
